text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"ཡི་གེ་ཨཾ་མེ་ཏོག་བནྡུ་ཀའི་མདོག་ལྟ་བུ་རང་གི་སྙིང་གར་བསྒོམས་ལ།","english":"One should not meditate on the syllable Aṃ, like the color of a Bandhuka flower, in one's own heart.","kind":"negation","why":"The source says to meditate on the syllable, but the English adds a 'not'.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: One should not meditate on the syllable Aṃ, like the color of a Bandhuka flower, in one's own heart.
contradictions.why: The source says to meditate on the syllable, but the English adds a 'not'.
